races.name: Cavani Signature Style Handicap

runners_data.name: Port Darwin
runners_data.note: Lead style front runner with class but proving difficult to catch right this season and disappointed last time
runners_data.comment: Turf winner last summer and runner-up at Kempton last week; in the mix back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: A fair 1m juvenile winner but not proving the easiest to catch right this season and he beat only one home in 1m2f Ripon handicap 25 days ago; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Miss Mambo
runners_data.note: Prominent racer taking a marked step up in trip on Tapeta debut with only modest form shown
runners_data.comment: Showed some ability in maidens and she needs watching in market on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Only modest form shown thus far and she beat only one on her handicap debut at Ripon (1m) 25 days ago; takes a marked step up in trip on her Tapeta debut.

runners_data.name: Grindleton
runners_data.note: Prominent type who advanced his form last time and appeals up in trip with Oisin Murphy taking over
runners_data.comment: Showing some consistency; ties in with Sports Day on Yarmouth reappearance form
runners_data.spotlight: Advanced his form with second of 11 in 1m2f Nottingham handicap two weeks ago; he's a player up in trip on his Tapeta debut with Oisin Murphy up.

runners_data.name: Goldfinder
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who hinted at promise and posted good fourth on handicap debut over this course and distance
runners_data.spotlight: Hinted at promise before posting a good fourth of nine on his first go in handicap company at Kempton (1m4f) 33 days ago; this son of Golden Horn is not out of things on his Tapeta debut.

runners_data.name: Kakirra
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse bidding for hat-trick but hit with 13lb weight rise after recent improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Much improved since sent handicapping and bids for a hat-trick following wins over C&D and at Bath (11.5f) last month; hit with a 13lb weights rise now but this son of Australia is still not taken lightly in his current mood.

runners_data.name: Risk Averse Rebel
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who made the frame in three runs here this season but disappointed last time on turf
runners_data.comment: Fairly solid efforts in three AW handicaps last month; others more likely to improve
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame on his first three runs here (at up to 9.5f) this season but a below-par fifth back on turf in 1m2f Doncaster handicap 39 days ago; not out of things back here if his stamina holds out.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Lead style runner who failed to improve on handicap debut but not written off yet for this trip
runners_data.comment: Unexposed gelding but this looks is competitive on handicap debut and others are preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Son of Camelot who failed to improve on his handicap debut when sixth of seven at Windsor (11.5f) 15 days ago; not written of yet though.

runners_data.name: Make It Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid placed efforts but carries warning about fading in the finish
runners_data.spotlight: Has posted solid placed efforts this spring, third of nine in 1m4f Kempton handicap 33 days ago; a bit more is needed from 1lb out of the handicap here though.

races.paceDynamic: Port Darwin and Sir Griflet will contest the early lead, with both showing confirmed front-running tendencies. The pace should be honest but not overly strong given only two natural leaders in an 8-runner field. Miss Mambo and Grindleton will track the leaders prominently, while the hold-up quartet of Goldfinder, Kakirra, Risk Averse Rebel and Make It Up will be positioned off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as they can position close enough to strike without relying on a strong gallop to bring back the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo or Grindleton can track the leaders without being shuffled back
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows prominent runners to stay in touch before quickening, with enough left in the tank to reel in the front pair. This suits horses who can race handily without being caught in a speed duel.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong between Port Darwin and Sir Griflet
scenarios.body: The two leaders go too fast early, setting up a perfect scenario for the closers to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Kakirra's recent form and tactical flexibility makes him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin or Sir Griflet manages to get a soft lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and kicks clear, with the hold-up horses unable to make up ground against the moderate pace. Port Darwin's class edge could tell if he gets an easy time of it.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 2f pole, allowing an outsider with a turn of foot to capitalise on the lack of early pace. Make It Up's fade-in-finish warning becomes less relevant in a sprint scenario.

watchPoints.text: Port Darwin and Sir Griflet both want the lead - if they engage in early speed duel it sets up the race for closers
Miss Mambo stepping up markedly in trip on Tapeta debut - market support would be significant given modest form
Grindleton has Oisin Murphy taking over and showed improved form last time - jockey booking suggests confidence
Kakirra attempting hat-trick but massive 13lb weight rise could halt his momentum despite recent improvement
Make It Up carries specific warning about fading in finish - watch for any signs of stopping in final furlong

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners_data.name: Mintana
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is honest, 33 days off but won here in February over this trip
runners_data.comment: Narrow winner of 7f classified here in January; held in two subsequent handicaps (7f/6f)
runners_data.spotlight: Landed 7f classified event at Lingfield in February and not disgraced in handicaps since, sixth of ten there (6f) last time; merits serious consideration back in classified company here.

runners_data.name: Mister McGregor
runners_data.note: Headgear changed again suggests connections seeking spark, hold-up style but Havlin can adapt tactically
runners_data.comment: 23-race maiden who has finished out the back in his last two runs; visor now tried
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to get his head in front and tried in different headgear when only ninth in 5f Nottingham handicap two weeks ago; headgear is changed again now.

runners_data.name: Diligent Henry
runners_data.note: Only front runner, 5lb claimer aboard but won C&D in October and faces no pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Dual AW winner but he's been off the boil in that sphere since December; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in October but yet to hit top form in handicaps this season, only 11th over 7f Doncaster 17 days ago; this is easier, though.

runners_data.name: Sanditon
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer, Charlie Johnston 5/37 last 14 days shows yard in reasonable form
runners_data.comment: 4lb lower than when gaining his sole success at Chelmsford in February; could bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough success at Chelmsford (7f) in February; not totally disgraced when fifth of nine in 7f Southwell handicap 12 days ago; not out of things lowered in grade.

runners_data.name: Star Of Atlantis
runners_data.note: Course winner but 42 days off, needs to bounce back from poor last effort
runners_data.comment: Stayed on well in a similar race here last month; drop in trip not certain to suit.
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner last May; good fifth over 8.5f here in March but she failed to beat a rival over C&D 42 days ago; needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Petes Diamond
runners_data.note: Winless in nine starts but tongue-tie debut and 7lb weight allowance provide hope
runners_data.comment: 0-8; one place behind stablemate Power Of Chora when midfield at Nottingham (6f) last time
runners_data.spotlight: Is 0-9 and he beat only one in 7f Lingfield handicap two weeks ago; tongue-tie is reached for now.

runners_data.name: Pacific Prince
runners_data.note: 77 days off and fading habit makes him hard to trust in any finish
runners_data.comment: Far from solid on form and mark of 50 shouldn't necessarily be taken at face value
runners_data.spotlight: Poor maiden who was tried in a hood when beating only one in 9.5f classified event here in March; it's easy to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Morning Suit
runners_data.note: 64 days off and poor recent form, visor added but others much preferred
runners_data.comment: 6f winner on Polytrack as 2yo; modest form since summer 2024; stamina query over new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Seems only poor nowadays and he failed to beat a rival in 8.5f handicap here in March; others are much preferred.

runners_data.name: Green Valentine
runners_data.note: 84 days off for new yard, was 6f scorer but yet to fire for current connections
runners_data.comment: Has rather lost her form since classified win in November; debut for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: A dual 6f scorer in 2025 for Alan Brown but yet to fire this term, only fifth of eight in 6f classified event here on her yard debut in March; lots more required after a break.

runners_data.name: Imthequeenofsheba
runners_data.note: 195 days off and weak juvenile form, major improvement needed for new trainer
runners_data.comment: Has cut little ice on both her runs; she's not easy to make a case for
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form in three runs (5f-7f) for Dominic Ffrench Davis in 2025; needs this yard switch to spark major progress.

races.paceDynamic: Diligent Henry is the sole confirmed front runner and should face minimal early pressure in this weak field. With most runners preferring hold-up tactics, he can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages without being harassed. The race will likely develop into a sprint finish as the large pack of hold-up horses converge in the final two furlongs. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than those needing to make ground from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Diligent Henry faces zero early pressure and gets easy sectionals
scenarios.body: The pace-setter maintains his advantage as the hold-up brigade arrive too late from their deep positions. Horses with some tactical pace like Mintana can get closest but the head start proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and compresses the field
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows proven finishers to close strongly in a bunched finish. Mintana's recent C&D form and Sanditon's February breakthrough put them in prime position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Mister McGregor or Star Of Atlantis track closer than usual
scenarios.body: Horses positioning in midfield rather than hold-up roles can exploit both the soft pace and avoid traffic problems. The new headgear on Mister McGregor could spark improvement in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Longshot Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders all underperform or meet trouble
scenarios.body: The weak overall quality allows an outsider like Petes Diamond with the tongue-tie addition to outrun odds. Green Valentine's early pace from her 6f wins could also translate at this trip.

watchPoints.text: Diligent Henry's early position - if he breaks slowly or gets challenged early, the whole pace dynamic changes
Mintana's jumping - if she breaks alertly she could track closer than usual and exploit the soft pace
Mister McGregor's headgear response - third different setup suggests connections are desperate for improvement
Weather conditions late in card - standard going but any deterioration could impact the hold-up horses
Market moves on Petes Diamond or Green Valentine - both could outrun odds if connections are confident about equipment changes

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners_data.name: Bungle Bay
runners_data.note: Eight-time course winner whose prominent style suits this pace setup, but 42 days off might leave him short of peak fitness
runners_data.spotlight: All eight wins have come here, five over this trip including in a 0-55 handicap six weeks ago; 1-1 at this level and very much respected.

runners_data.name: Dr Ali
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose 6f preference is a concern at 7f, but wide draw in stall 10 suits his come-from-behind style perfectly
runners_data.comment: Doubled his tally when reeling in the long-time leader at Wolverhampton a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: Just about stays this far, but his best form including both wins (one here) has come over 6f; drawn widest.

runners_data.name: Vitalline
runners_data.note: Serial slow-starter whose hold-up style perfectly matches this race shape, though 36 days absence could impact sharpness
runners_data.comment: Will be happier back up from 6f but is yet another who'll need some luck from a wide stall
runners_data.spotlight: Serial slow-starter who has won seven times over 6f/7f on the AW; held in handicaps lately, but the return to this level offers hope and he's capable of playing a part if things pan out his way.

runners_data.name: My Mate Beattie
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who is 0-23 lifetime and has shown modest form for current connections across 11 starts
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame several times for her previous yard including on the AW, but modest so far in five starts for this yard and now 0-23; hard to fancy, even in this company.

runners_data.name: Mythical Isle
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie removal after 57-day break adds uncertainty to this 0-11 maiden making his debut at this claiming level
runners_data.comment: Maiden who's turned in three solid efforts in C&D handicaps; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11; has made the frame a few times over 6f here and makes his debut at this level, but he does have something to prove back up in trip; tongue-tie removed after one use.

runners_data.name: Miss Moonshine
runners_data.note: Inconsistent hold-up mare whose hit-and-miss form makes her unreliable despite the favorable pace setup
runners_data.comment: Wildly inconsistent mare; hard to know what to expect as always
runners_data.spotlight: Has become very much hit and miss, her Lingfield dead-heat (7f, Polytrack) in February standing well above her other recent efforts; not sure what to expect.

runners_data.name: Filey Beach
runners_data.note: Front runner whose 0-6 AW record contrasts sharply with recent turf success, creating serious surface transfer concerns
runners_data.comment: C&D apprentice winner ten days ago; escapes a penalty; key player in winnable contest.
runners_data.spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick after winning two handicaps at Catterick (7f, good) last month; respected if able to transfer that form back to the AW (0-6).

runners_data.name: Telling Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with finishing concerns but benefits from 7-day turnaround and 10lb weight advantage as a 3-year-old
runners_data.comment: Went close on AW in March but soundly beaten on turf on both starts since and now 0-9
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 but was only beaten a neck in a 0-60 handicap over 6f here when last on the AW in March; has been placed over C&D and is shortlisted dropped to this level for the first time.

runners_data.name: Frankali
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose early-season Polytrack placings look better than recent poor efforts, but Oisin Murphy booking adds interest
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 and recent efforts not so hot, but twice placed in 7f Polytrack handicaps at the start of the year; worth considering down in grade with Oisin Murphy in the saddle.

runners_data.name: Angel's Call
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best form comes over shorter trips, making the 7f distance a significant tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: His win came over 5f and his stamina is still a major query
runners_data.spotlight: 1-17 with his best form (including his sole win) coming over shorter trips; down the pecking order.

races.paceDynamic: Filey Beach is the only confirmed front runner and will get an uncontested lead from stall 8, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Bungle Bay may track prominently from stall 2 but won't challenge the pace early, while the remaining eight runners including Dr Ali, Vitalline, Telling Time, and Frankali all prefer to come from off the pace. With just one pace-setter in a field of predominantly hold-up horses, this creates an ideal scenario for closers who can unleash late kicks. The tactical verdict strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the steady tempo and finish with late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Filey Beach sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows closers to conserve energy and produce sustained finishing kicks in the straight. Hold-up specialists like Dr Ali, Vitalline, and Frankali can time their challenges perfectly from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Filey Beach wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner's early lead is commanding enough that no closer can catch up
scenarios.body: Filey Beach's hat-trick bid succeeds as the soft fractions allow him to kick clear entering the straight before the field can respond. His recent Catterick form proves superior to this AW opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bungle Bay course specialist
scenarios.trigger: If Bungle Bay's superior course knowledge allows him to find the perfect stalking position
scenarios.body: The eight-time Wolverhampton winner uses his intimate track familiarity to position perfectly behind Filey Beach before striking decisively. His 7f course record and recent 0-55 handicap win here gives him the edge over less course-suited rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Filey Beach goes too slowly early and multiple horses make simultaneous moves
scenarios.body: The crawling early tempo results in a messy sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial and form lines are thrown out. This chaos scenario can produce surprise results from horses like Miss Moonshine or Angel's Call who thrive in scrappy finishes.

watchPoints.text: Filey Beach's AW record is 0-6 despite strong recent turf form, creating serious doubts about surface transfer ability
Dr Ali's 6f preference could see him struggle to last home at 7f despite the favorable tactical setup
Vitalline's reputation as a serial slow-starter becomes critical in a race where early positioning matters less than usual
Bungle Bay's eight course wins versus 42-day layoff creates a classic fitness versus experience angle to monitor
Telling Time's tendency to fade in the finish could be negated by the steady early pace but remains a concern

races.name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mr Noble
runners_data.note: Only proven winner but vulnerable if allowed uncontested lead then challenged late
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 5-4 when beating six rivals on his Newcastle debut (6f, Tapeta) in December; three of those behind have won since and he has to be taken seriously despite the absence and the penalty.

runners_data.name: Manly Fireball
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse perfectly suited to likely slow pace scenario
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in four of his five starts on the AW (including over C&D), the latest when beaten under a length by a rival rated 10lb superior in a Kempton novice (7f, Polytrack) 13 days ago; relatively exposed but still a major player in this field.

runners_data.name: Navertity
runners_data.note: Newcomer with strong pedigree but completely unknown quantity on racecourse debut
runners_data.spotlight: 70,000euros yearling; dam French 1m-1m2f winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 3; RPR 109), half-sister to French/Swiss 1m4f Listed winner My Old Husband, out of 1m-1m3f winner; likely she will need further than this in time, but still well worth a market check on debut with Oisin Murphy booked.

runners_data.name: Rumble Ruby
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but showed clear stamina limitations when fading badly on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 when well beaten on her Southwell debut (6f, Tapeta) in April.

runners_data.name: Celtic Chariot
runners_data.note: Showed promise at Doncaster and handles prominent tactics well in moderate company
runners_data.comment: Displayed ability on debut at Doncaster three weeks ago but needs a sizeable step forward
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise when third of five on his Doncaster debut (7f, good to firm) in April and faced a stiff task when well held in a valuable novice at York (1m, good) last month; half-brother to an AW winner in Canada, but not sure the drop in trip is a positive.

runners_data.name: Luckie Lucas
runners_data.note: Long absence and poor form make this a non-starter despite prominent style
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in either start over 6f/7f on turf/Tapeta in April last year; no appeal.

runners_data.name: Starborn
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type but fading pattern suggests stamina/ability concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in her first two starts over 6f/7f on turf/Polytrack ten months apart; handicaps become an option after this; probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Cool Doc Boy
runners_data.note: Regressed since promising debut but hold-up style suits expected race shape
runners_data.spotlight: Promising when second of ten on his Kempton debut (6f, Polytrack) in November, but has regressed in both outings over this C&D since; the first may have come too soon and the latest came after a five-month absence, so a resurgence wouldn't be a completed surprise.

runners_data.name: Rib Shot
runners_data.note: Seven month break and trainer change create too many question marks
runners_data.spotlight: Held in two Chelmsford maidens (6f, Polytrack) for Denis Quinn in October; plenty of improvement needed on first start for new trainer after seven months off.

runners_data.name: Mayflower Rock
runners_data.note: Improving but still well below required standard despite recent Windsor fourth
runners_data.comment: 66-1, never recovered from a slow start on AW last month; likely to need more time
runners_data.spotlight: Improved from April's debut over C&D when fourth of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 100-1) last month; shortlisted in this field if taking another step forward.

races.paceDynamic: Mr Noble will dictate terms from the front with no obvious challenger for the early lead, creating a measured tempo through the opening stages. Several prominent runners including Rumble Ruby, Celtic Chariot and Luckie Lucas will sit just behind but none are confirmed pace-pressers. The lack of early speed suggests a pedestrian gallop building to a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can unleash late kicks, with front-runners vulnerable to being swamped in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Noble sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows hold-up horses to get into perfect striking positions before unleashing devastating late runs. Closers with turn of foot will have too much firepower for the tiring leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Noble Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Noble kicks clear approaching the final furlong and maintains his advantage
scenarios.body: The proven winner uses his class edge and race fitness to repel late challengers despite the tactical disadvantage. His December form gives him enough quality to withstand pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners apply early pressure and create a more honest gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents a bunch finish, suiting horses with sustained speed rather than pure closing kicks. Prominent racers get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Noble stops quickly and multiple closers converge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The leader's capitulation creates a blanket finish where any hold-up horse with a clear passage can prevail. Experience and jockey strength become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Mr Noble could steal this if allowed completely uncontested lead and maintains stamina
Navertity's market movement will reveal stable confidence in this well-bred newcomer
Manly Fireball needs clear running room in final furlong given hold-up tactics
Cool Doc Boy's early positioning will indicate whether connections expect bounce-back
Celtic Chariot must break better than recent starts to secure ideal prominent spot

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Knightmare
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should appreciate the drop back to AW conditions and shorter trip
runners_data.comment: 15-race maiden; the odd run that makes him of interest but opposable on balance
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 but has made the frame eight times; has been racing over further on turf, but shouldn't have a problem with the drop in trip back on the AW and drops to this level for the first time; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Ciotog
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with proven course and distance form but on lengthy losing run, needs the market to show confidence
runners_data.comment: All wins at about 1m, including four times at Bath; has bits of 1m2f form
runners_data.spotlight: Has plenty of form over C&D including two wins; losing run up to 18, but he has never raced down at this level before so can't be dismissed by any means; stable also runs Sorted.

runners_data.name: Lady Aiyana
runners_data.note: Prominent style runner but has questions to answer after poor showing in tongue-tie on stable debut last time
runners_data.comment: Six-race maiden last term for previous yard; tongue-tie fitted
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7; ran terribly in the first-time tongue-tie (retained) on stable debut at Bath (11.7f, firm) last month; has enough to prove after that from her wide draw, despite dropping in grade.

runners_data.name: Sorted
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with improving handicap form over course and distance but returns from 10-week absence
runners_data.spotlight: Has improved for the switch to handicaps, being placed in the last two over C&D (unfortunate not to finish a bit closer last time); off ten weeks and drawn widest, but still a player in this company.

runners_data.name: Lady Of Clover
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with upside having placed twice in similar grade, including over course and distance
runners_data.comment: Best effort so far when third at Yarmouth two weeks ago; each-way shout for in-form yard
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two of her three starts in 0-55 handicaps, including over C&D; has more upside than most and much respected.

runners_data.name: Lady Delila
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with course and distance form but now on 18-race losing streak despite each-way chances
runners_data.comment: 0-17 overall but competitive in classifieds on last three outings; new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Placed three times at this level on Tapeta for Iain Jardine at the start of the year, including over C&D; now 0-18, but still holds each-way claims again on debut for her new yard.

runners_data.name: Pam's Sonnet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been well held in four starts this year including twice over shorter trips here
runners_data.comment: Her first realistic assignment today but not obviously well treated
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in all four starts this year including two over 6f here; much more needed, even at this level.

runners_data.name: Rogers Dream
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner making stable and AW debut after 20 months off with limited turf form
runners_data.spotlight: Limited ability in six starts over 6f/7f on turf in 2024; probably best watched on stable/AW debut after 20 months off.

runners_data.name: Raise The Stakes
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but has faded badly in recent starts despite gear changes and gelding operation
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to a few winners; been gelded and goes in first-time headgear; market useful
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way in four starts over 7f/1m on turf/AW, with being gelded and new cheekpieces making little difference last time; drops in grade, but still needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Antique Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with little to recommend after poor showings for current connections in various grades
runners_data.comment: Habitual slow starter for whom it is yet to click since joining R. Carr; focus elsewhere.
runners_data.spotlight: Some ability in one start for Andrew Balding, but little to shout about in five outings for this yard; hard to recommend despite another drop in grade.

runners_data.name: Northern Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner adding visor after being well beaten in three maiden attempts over 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in three 7f maidens, the latest here last month on return from a lengthy absence; visor needs to make a big difference.

runners_data.name: A Daughters Love
runners_data.note: Hold-up style making debut for new yard after disappointing Irish form over various distances
runners_data.comment: No sign of winning potential in four runs at two, no better at the Curragh on return.
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in six starts over 5f-7f on turf/Polytrack in Ireland; market should indicate what is expected starting out for a new yard.

runners_data.name: Thomas Tallis
runners_data.note: Hold-up two-year-old returning from nine-month break having been gelded with no previous form of note
runners_data.spotlight: Astronomical prices when failing to beat a rival in three 7f novices on turf/Tapeta last year; returns from nine months off having been gelded; little appeal.

races.paceDynamic: Rogers Dream will lead from the gates with no other confirmed front runners, setting an uncontested pace over the extended mile trip. The majority field are hold-up horses who will settle behind, with Knightmare and Lady Aiyana providing some early position from prominent styles. This creates a modest tempo early before the field fans out in the straight for the finish. This pace profile strongly favors horses with tactical speed who can position handy - the prominent runners and forward hold-up types will benefit most from the lack of early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Rogers Dream gets an easy lead and finds improvement on stable debut
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the front runner to dictate terms and kick for home with enough left in reserve. Despite limited ability shown previously, the tactical advantage proves decisive against this modest field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate and prominent runners can track and pounce
scenarios.body: Knightmare or Lady Aiyana can sit second or third, let Rogers Dream do the donkey work, then strike in the final furlong when the leader tires. Their superior class and race fitness proves telling in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough in the middle sections to set up a closer
scenarios.body: Lady Of Clover or Sorted get the perfect trip from their hold-up style as some pace pressure emerges. They can use their proven form at this level to mount a late challenge when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Rogers Dream goes too slow and gets swamped by the entire field
scenarios.body: The leader sets such pedestrian fractions that the race becomes a sprint finish involving most of the field. Fitness and recent form become decisive factors in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Rogers Dream could steal this if getting uncontested fractions and finding significant improvement on stable debut after the long break
Watch the market for Ciotog who has winning course and distance form but hasn't won in 18 attempts
Lady Of Clover has scope for further improvement in this grade and could be well positioned from her hold-up style
Knightmare's recent turf form suggests ability but needs to handle the surface switch back to artificial
Any significant market support for A Daughters Love would be telling on her debut for new trainer Thomas Dowling

races.name: Cavani Classic Style Handicap (Div I)

runners_data.name: Thehunnebelllegacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits expected pace scenario but 12-day turnaround after six-month layoff raises stamina questions at this trip
runners_data.comment: Too keen when fourth at Newcastle final run; can't be ruled out if more settled in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Modest juvenile maiden; proved more settled and not disgraced after six months off when fifth of eight in 7f Catterick handicap 12 days ago; one to consider with that run under her belt.

runners_data.name: Amazing Anita
runners_data.note: Prominent style gives tactical edge and recent C&D second shows she handles track, but stable change adds unknown element
runners_data.comment: Promising reappearance in March but no progress in two runs since; tricky draw; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Fair maiden who signed off for James Fanshawe with a good second of 12 over C&D four weeks ago; since changed hands for 7,000gns and not out of things for her new stable in a headgear change.

runners_data.name: Enduring Story
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner improving in handicaps but low rating suggests she needs more progression to compete at this level
runners_data.comment: This more realistic now handicapping but want to see some support before considering her
runners_data.spotlight: Took a step forward on her first go in handicaps with fifth of nine at Redcar (7f) 15 days ago; she needs to build on it.

runners_data.name: Distillation
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making handicap debut but trainer's poor recent form and tendency to fade in finishes are major concerns
runners_data.comment: RPRs in the 40s last season and has since been gelded; can only be watched
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to offer much in his three runs, gelded/off five months before coming in ninth of 11 in 6f Kempton maiden last month; needs this switch to handicaps to spark major progress.

runners_data.name: City Of Dreams
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose AW form is solid but turf debut was poor, blinkers application suggests connections expect improvement
runners_data.comment: Launched handicap career with two good AW runs this year, and may still have potential
runners_data.spotlight: In good form without winning on the AW but he came in last of eight on his turf debut in 1m Wetherby handicap last time; blinkers go on now.

runners_data.name: South Coast Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up style matches race shape perfectly but form has deteriorated since promising C&D second in March
runners_data.comment: Runner-up at Wolverhampton (7f) penultimate; this sharp track could suit her run style.
runners_data.spotlight: Enters calculations on the form of her C&D second in March but she's been well below that form in 7f handicaps at Kempton and Catterick since; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Stole My Heart
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who has shown little for two different trainers and faces stronger opposition than recent outings
runners_data.comment: Modest sixth at Kempton in December; has left Clive Cox and makes her handicap/turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Little show in three runs for Clive Cox and she fared no better for her new yard when eighth of 15 in 6f handicap at Salisbury 19 days ago; needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Veld
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping back to ideal trip after being too keen over longer distance at Nottingham two weeks ago
runners_data.comment: Bred to be suited by this new trip on turf/handicap debut; another step forward is likely
runners_data.spotlight: Brought along steadily but she proved too free on her handicap/turf debut when eighth of 11 at Nottingham (1m2f) two weeks ago; she could still do better back in trip here.

runners_data.name: Lady Vanguard
runners_data.note: Sole front runner whose blinkers suggest tactical issues, but lack of pace pressure should help her cause significantly
runners_data.spotlight: Improved on her handicap debut with fourth at Yarmouth (1m) in April but she came in last of eight in 1m2f Ripon handicap 25 days ago; blinkers are reached for now.

runners_data.name: Zoulette
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with strong recent Leicester second showing clear improvement, seven-day turnaround indicates confidence
runners_data.comment: Late headway over 6f on recent handicap debut and this return to 7f could prove ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Zoustar filly who took a big step forward on her second handicap run with a clear second of nine at Leicester (7f) a week ago, collared only late on; she can race off a 1lb lower mark here so major shout with Billy Loughnane again up.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Vanguard will take them along as the sole recognized front runner, with Amazing Anita and City Of Dreams likely to sit prominent early. The pace should be sustainable rather than punishing with only one horse committed to the lead, allowing the field to stay in touch through the middle stages. This creates a race where horses can travel kindly in behind before the real test comes in the final 2f when stamina and finishing kick become crucial. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce a strong late finish over the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Vanguard sets a steady tempo and the pace doesn't collapse
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows closers to get into perfect striking positions, with the race becoming a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter most. Hold-up specialists like Zoulette, South Coast Star, and Veld can unleash their finishing kicks when it counts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Amazing Anita or City Of Dreams can secure an ideal stalking position behind Lady Vanguard
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic problems that often snare hold-up horses in sprint finishes. Their tactical position allows them to kick clear before the closers can respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pacesetter Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Vanguard's blinkers sharpen her focus and she handles the sustained pace better than expected
scenarios.body: The front runner maintains her advantage through superior fitness and tactical position while her rivals struggle to peg her back in the testing ground. Her early advantage proves decisive despite carrying the burden of making the running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Vanguard goes too slowly or ties up badly in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with no true pace to aim at, favoring horses with natural tactical speed who can quicken from any position. The lack of a true gallop neutralizes the natural closers' finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Lady Vanguard could set fractions that are either too slow early or collapse completely in the straight given her recent disappointing efforts
Amazing Anita and City Of Dreams must secure clean passages from their prominent positions as traffic problems could easily derail their chances
Zoulette's recent Leicester form gives her a clear fitness edge but watch if the quick turnaround affects her finishing kick
South Coast Star needs to recapture her March form to be competitive and any early signs of enthusiasm could signal a return to her best
Veld must settle better than at Nottingham where she raced too keenly, as similar tactics would be fatal over this shorter trip

races.name: Cavani Classic Style Handicap (Div II)

runners_data.name: Dusk Damsel
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from poor turf debut but previous handicap second shows ability on this surface
runners_data.spotlight: Has something to prove after dismal effort on turf debut at Salisbury (6f, good) last month but looked to have races in her when second of ten on handicap debut at Lingfield (6f, Polytrack) in April; considered.

runners_data.name: Power Of Chora
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer ready for 7f return after staying-on sixth suggests this trip suits better
runners_data.comment: Plugged on for sixth on her handicap debut at Nottingham over 6f; steps back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Out of the frame in four starts, but looked ready for a return to this trip when a staying-on sixth of 15 on handicap debut at Nottingham (6f, good; first-time tongue-tie) in April; not dismissed.

runners_data.name: Musical Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up winner over course and distance but 5lb higher than previous victory raises difficulty
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointed when favourite at Catterick (7f, good) 12 days ago, but had previously made just about all when winning convincingly over C&D; still 5lb higher, but much respected back here.

runners_data.name: Ndoto
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer making handicap debut after regressing in recent starts needs resurgence
runners_data.spotlight: Has regressed in two starts since finishing third of six on her debut over 6f here in March; needs a resurgence on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Electrocution
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with course and distance win from 2lb lower but recent form disappointing
runners_data.spotlight: Did well in AW handicaps at the start of the year including winning over C&D from 2lb lower in February; last two starts leave plenty to be desired and he needs the blinkers to help turn things around.

runners_data.name: Labiche
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fading tendency that could prove costly in competitive handicap
runners_data.comment: Needs to build on reappearance effort; this looks a deeper race
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in five starts, not achieving much a remote when third of six on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) in April; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Based
runners_data.note: Prominent performer with course and distance second but turf debut was well beaten effort
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten when joint-favourite for his turf debut at Lingfield (7f, good) a fortnight ago, but had previously finished second of 12 on handicap debut over this C&D (first start since being gelded); high on the list returned to this venue.

runners_data.name: Inclusive
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency and well held in recent starts for new connections
runners_data.comment: Left J Fanshawe for 9,000gns in February; best watched on stable debut off 14-week break.
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort for James Fanshawe when third of nine behind a flourishing rival at Southwell (6f, Tapeta) on New Year's Day, but twice well held since including on stable debut back there last month; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Warriors Choice
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 231-day break with previous turf form over this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Hinted at ability in a couple of starts over this trip on turf last summer, but her last two starts over 1m with cheekpieces added (including on Polytrack) were moderate; plenty to prove after eight months off.

races.paceDynamic: Dusk Damsel and Warriors Choice will likely contest the early lead with Labiche and Based tracking prominently, creating a moderate tempo through the first half of this 7f contest. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic given only two confirmed front runners in a field of nine. Musical Soldier, Power Of Chora, Ndoto, Electrocution and Inclusive will settle further back and rely on their finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up performers who can exploit the even gallop and produce late surges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the leaders weaken from 2f out
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get perfect positioning to unleash their finishing kicks as the prominent runners tire. Musical Soldier and Power Of Chora can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Dusk Damsel or Based maintain strong galloping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The horses racing prominently avoid the usual fate of front runners and sustain their efforts to the line. Based's recent second over course and distance gives him the edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses produce finishing kicks simultaneously in final furlong
scenarios.body: A blanket finish develops as several closers hit the front together creating a photo finish scenario. Electrocution's previous course and distance winner could edge it in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Dusk Damsel gets uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner exploits soft fractions to build an unassailable advantage before the closers can respond. Her prominent style gives her tactical advantage if allowed easy time in front.

watchPoints.text: Musical Soldier could bounce back to winning form if settling better than at Catterick where he disappointed as favourite
Dusk Damsel's front-running tactics might prove more effective if she gets uncontested lead from Taylor Fisher
Power Of Chora showed staying-on ability last time suggesting this 7f trip could unlock improvement
Based needs to transfer AW form to turf after disappointing debut on grass at Lingfield
Electrocution requires return to early season AW handicap form that saw him win over course and distance

races.name: Race And Rest At The Holiday Inn Handicap

runners_data.name: Study Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with 5lb penalty and wide draw after Leicester win, needs luck in running from stall 12
runners_data.comment: Very close fourth over 1m here last time and could be in the mix if seeing out the trip
runners_data.spotlight: Gained his first win since his debut when scoring by half a length at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) a week ago; has a 5lb penalty and the outside stall to contend with, but he remains unexposed over this sort of trip; hood removed.

runners_data.name: City Escape
runners_data.note: Five-time C&D winner but rusty on stable debut last time, proven AW performer off reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner over C&D and 2lb lower than for the latest; never figured on last month's stable debut at Leicester after 217 days off, but she may have needed it and no great surprise if she ran well.

runners_data.name: Age Of Time
runners_data.note: Sole front runner switching from Ian Williams to Steph Hollinshead, returning cheekpieces that helped him win C&D
runners_data.comment: Remains consistent and enters calculations for his new yard after three months off
runners_data.spotlight: Placed off this mark in his last four starts on the AW for Ian Williams, which is the same mark from which he won over C&D (first-time cheekpieces) in October; each-way claims if maintaining his form for new stable; fifth 7.00 Wolverhampton Monday.

runners_data.name: Beachborough Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style, consistent AW performer but poor last start on turf, first-time tongue-tie applied
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW for new yard and she's respected back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Poor effort at Windsor last time perhaps not hard to forgive in view of her turf record and she proved most consistent on the AW before that, including when beaten less than a length over C&D in April; respected back in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Silkies Sib
runners_data.note: Strong C&D record (1233), back off winning mark with cheekpieces reapplied, proven at this level
runners_data.comment: Scored over C&D in December (off 3lb lower) and at Chelmsford in February.
runners_data.spotlight: Record over C&D reads 1233 and he's back off the same mark as when successful at Chelmsford (1m2f, Polytrack) in February; player in the returning cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Roman Secret
runners_data.note: Beat Arlecchino's Rex by short head C&D in April, struggled over longer trip last time at Southwell
runners_data.spotlight: Was returning from six months off and drawn wide when beating Arlecchino's Rex by a short head over C&D in April, but found the trip too far at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) 13 days later; still 3lb higher than for the win, but still high on the list back under these conditions.

runners_data.name: Arlecchino's Rex
runners_data.note: Excellent course form this year, short-head second to Roman Secret here, should find more improvement
runners_data.comment: Running consistently round here all year at the bottom level; should go well again
runners_data.spotlight: Record here this year reads 34513323 including a short-head defeat by Roman Secret over this trip in April; likely to go well and there shouldn't be much between them again.

runners_data.name: Port Noir
runners_data.note: Four wins this year including two C&D, but last two efforts disappointing, veteran needs to bounce back
runners_data.comment: Won four AW races (1m to 9.5f) this year; having second crack at 1m2f on her 111th start
runners_data.spotlight: Has enjoyed a good year with four wins, two of them over C&D; last two efforts leave her with a bit to prove, though.

runners_data.name: Shaws Phoenix
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from wind surgery, 0-16 career record but could provide early pace pressure
runners_data.spotlight: Placed a few times, but 0-16 and well held on stable debut/return at Southwell (1m, Tapeta; first start since wind surgery) in April; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Luan
runners_data.note: Eight months off with tongue-tie applied, hasn't been competitive in any of four career starts
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't finished within 11l of the winner in four starts; needs a transformation back from eight months off with a tongue-tie applied.

runners_data.name: Poke The Bear
runners_data.note: Winter Polytrack winner at higher weights, but recent form poor and trip may stretch stamina
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW over the winter but below par on last three runs; more to prove on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Won three times on the Lingfield Polytrack (7f/1m) during the winter and just 1lb higher than for the latest, but not at his best lately; others more solid.

runners_data.name: Cherry Hill
runners_data.note: Struggles away from Kempton Polytrack, wind surgery ineffective, prominent style could suit pace scenario
runners_data.spotlight: 1-21 with her best AW form coming on the Kempton Polytrack; lightly raced and out of form these days with wind surgery making no difference last time.

races.paceDynamic: Age Of Time is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms throughout this 1m1½f contest. With only Shaws Phoenix and Cherry Hill likely to race prominently early, Age Of Time should get an uncontested lead and control the fractions. The large field of hold-up horses including Study Up, City Escape, Silkies Sib, and Roman Secret will track behind in a bunched pack. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind the early leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time gets soft early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner controls the tempo and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. Early positioning proves decisive on this tight AW track with 12 runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Through Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine enough to set up closers, with Roman Secret and Silkies Sib finding gaps to mount late challenges. Class tells in the final furlong despite early positioning disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Shaws Phoenix or Cherry Hill press Age Of Time early
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more genuine, softening up the leader for a horse that's been tracking prominently. The race develops into a straight battle between the early pace angles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If City Escape or Arlecchino's Rex overcome their poor draws
scenarios.body: Local knowledge and C&D form prove decisive despite tactical disadvantages. One of the proven course performers finds a way through the pack.

watchPoints.text: Age Of Time breaking slowly from the stalls would completely change the pace dynamic with no other natural leaders
Study Up and other hold-up horses getting squeezed for room in the straight with 12 runners on the AW track
Roman Secret and Arlecchino's Rex renewing their April rivalry where they finished separated by a short head
City Escape showing any early zip after her rusty stable debut following 217 days off
Silkies Sib getting the gaps his hold-up style requires given the likely traffic problems from his draw
